title: quarkus-amazon-dynamodb and quarkus-smallrye-fault-tolerance combination causes CNFE
body:
quarkus-amazon-dynamodb and quarkus-smallrye-fault-tolerance combination causes CNFE
java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: software.amazon.awssdk.http.urlconnection.UrlConnectionHttpClient$Builder

url-connection-client is marked as optional - https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/master/extensions/amazon-dynamodb/runtime/pom.xml#L45

Steps to reproduce:
use microprofile-fault-tolerance-quickstart https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus-quickstarts/tree/development/microprofile-fault-tolerance-quickstart
```
cd microprofile-fault-tolerance-quickstart
mvn quarkus:add-extension -Dextensions="quarkus-amazon-dynamodb"
mvn clean verify
```
